name: Mafia
desc:
Let the games begin...

😴 Each Night:
🔪 Mafia – Your goal is to secretly kill players until no one is left.
🔫 Sheriff – Your goal is to shoot the Murderer before they win.
❤️‍🩹 Doctor – Your goal is to keep players alive by saving them from attacks.
👤 Civilian – Your goal is to help find and vote out the Murderer.

🥱 Each Morning:
Everyone talks and votes for who they think is the Murderer.
The player with the most votes is eliminated.
